context:
Goal: you cull the design-churn mockups down to the ones worth building.
Problem (goal): all 11 finishable mockups are finished and gathered (228 files, branch head e97fd4af), nothing is built or merged, and only you can cull; the page cannot hold them all as pictures.
Based on (read): the coordinator's note of 2026-11-21 13:54 CST: the README table on the design-churn branch lists each mockup and its notes; each notes file lists its owner questions and "Owner grant: yes" items; the coordinator recommends you mark each mockup keep or drop from that table.
Based on (read): two facts every designer reports: no large-phone size is written anywhere (item 109 is still open), and the mockup checker faults the ruled Cochin content font on every mockup (a claude-settings carry).
Departs from: main has no design-churn review — this adds one owner review.
Waiting on: your answer; the coordinator does nothing further meanwhile.

options.gain: You see everything and choose freely.
options.how: You open the README table, review the mockups and notes, and mark each "Owner grant: yes" item keep or cull.
options.label: I review the whole folder myself
options.lose: About 200 files, most of them as links, not pictures on this page.

options.gain: The best few arrive as pictures on this page, which is where you work.
options.how: The coordinator has the designers pick a short list, I put those mockups on the page as pictures, and you cull from them first.
options.label: Short list first, as pictures on the page
options.lose: A mockup outside the short list waits for a later pass.

title: Review the design-churn mockups and cull: the whole folder yourself, or a short list on the page first?
why: You asked for pictures inside this page, and about 200 files do not fit there; a short list does.
